source_description: Selected NR-0 profile originally exported from b91748b and accepted at aeae955, with dispatch/completion preservation at 304b5eb. Current pins also cover the actual post-admission request_current orchestration and its 25 extracted decision/data-flow obligations. Fresh validation is recorded with this orchestration increment; older frozen records certify their original sources. No native I/O refinement or signed binary/source certificate is implied.

selected_runtime.host_source: synthetic file credential; no OAuth source override
selected_runtime.guest_session: sequential, software client identity bound to mTLS certificate
selected_runtime.provider: local loopback HTTPS fixture with synthetic credential
selected_runtime.coordination: no coordinator configured; optional check_coordination call remains reachable
selected_runtime.approval: no host control socket in writes=deny fixture
selected_runtime.nonzero_proof_limit: not a distinct restricted production binary; runtime startup/config restriction is unproved

S-GUEST-FRAME.basis: Rust GuestFrame::send emits canonical JSONL after native release or fixed error; live mTLS capture tests observe full frame bytes.
S-GUEST-FRAME.open_obligation: Link all write attempts, serialization exceptions, and errors to W5 observations; no universal correspondence yet

S-GUEST-CLOSE.basis: TLS server handles stream framing, watchdog, TLS errors and closure; some local tests observe EOF and denial frames.
S-GUEST-CLOSE.open_obligation: Include termination and partial/failed send as public observation or explicit excluded channel

S-PROVIDER-HTTPS.basis: The actual manifest entry passes a source-owned request adapter to the consuming kernel. The adapter prepares phase/write authority, calls owned dispatch and retains its exact report receipt on every return. Primitive audit/current/TLS/send semantics and other I/O remain separate obligations; native HTTPS witnesses record arrivals.
S-PROVIDER-HTTPS.open_obligation: Account for exact write attempt, partial sends, DNS/redirect/dependency reachability and per-connection errors

S-OAUTH-HTTPS.basis: Selected ManifestCase uses credential_source kind=file with no oauth/source_override; OAuth login/refresh lives in host operator flows.
S-OAUTH-HTTPS.open_obligation: Show alternate OAuth source cannot be silently selected for the frozen config; audit host startup/control separately

S-HOST-AUDIT.basis: Session startup emits session_open and issued; audited dispatch precedes provider sends; completion audit precedes successful release.
S-HOST-AUDIT.open_obligation: Specify append/flush/fsync acknowledgements, failures and crash durability, and link every typed event

S-HOST-STDOUT.basis: Native bridge startup emits operational output to host operator, distinct from authenticated guest TLS channel.
S-HOST-STDOUT.open_obligation: Review stdout payloads and all log/debug call paths for protected bytes

S-HOST-STDERR.basis: Bridge errors and dependency diagnostics can reach host stderr.
S-HOST-STDERR.open_obligation: Review all error/unwind/drop paths and logging callbacks, including dependencies

S-HOST-PRIVATE-STATE.basis: Host stores vault/provider credential, registry, TLS keys, policy and audit outside guest; no guest filesystem access is assumed.
S-HOST-PRIVATE-STATE.open_obligation: Validate file permissions and eventual actual VM mount/host isolation; do not claim OS separation is proved

S-HOST-ADMIN.basis: Authority/admin actions are separate host process interfaces, not manifest guest verbs.
S-HOST-ADMIN.open_obligation: Inventory accessible host sockets, credentials and capabilities; actual VM access controls are an external assumption

S-LEGACY-UNIX.basis: Bridge::new_provider selects Backend::Provider; Backend::Socket/legacy Python forward remains a separate constructor.
S-LEGACY-UNIX.open_obligation: Show production deployment truly chooses Provider backend and cannot fall back under errors or guest input

S-COORDINATOR-HTTPS.basis: ManifestCase has no coordination_file; native Session::request still calls check_coordination, which must be inert without optional coordinator.
S-COORDINATOR-HTTPS.open_obligation: Verify absence of coordinator member/channel configuration in the startup instance; enumerate optional paths separately

S-COORDINATOR-REPLY.basis: Dedicated coordinator server/member reply process; not selected by manifest guest frame.
S-COORDINATOR-REPLY.open_obligation: Assume separate server privileges, TLS identities and filesystem; inspect effect reachability when deployed

S-COORDINATOR-ADMIN.basis: Coordinator operator CLI is separate from guest bridge.
S-COORDINATOR-ADMIN.open_obligation: Prove/validate no guest host-control access in deployed VM; maintain separate coordinator assurance

S-WRITE-APPROVAL-CONTROL.basis: Chosen manifest fixture defaults writes=deny, creating no optional control.sock approval channel.
S-WRITE-APPROVAL-CONTROL.open_obligation: Review full configuration and selected op writes; fixture allows explicit writes override in other tests
